1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “他们去很多不一样的地方” / Formula: subject + 去了 + 很多 + different places / Correct: “他们去了很多不同的地方。” Use 了 because this is a completed event in the story. “不同的地方” is also more natural than “不一样的地方” here.

items.reason: The narrative action is completed, so 去 needs 了; 不一样的地方 is also acceptable, though 不同的地方 is natural.
